description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Oketra.
When God-Eternal Oketra dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Oketra's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Oketra.
As God-Eternal Oketra is a Lhurgoyf due to Arcane Adaptation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Oketra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
